fact: On 27 March 2026 the Prime Minister opened the Census Coordinating Council meeting, which approved the census cartography plan (825 cartographers, 161 districts, to finish by March 2027); the 2027 census is budgeted at 110 million dollars, 45 million secured including 12 million from the World Bank for cartography.
title: Primeira-Ministra destaca modernização digital e coordenação no Censo Populacional 2027
